contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:NP02; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10A2/NaturalNoPonzi.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994.naturalBound_implies_noPonzi; dep:NP01; source:A93] The exported theorem proves almost-everywhere existence of a finite real L≥0 with (1+r)^(-T)*a_(T+1)→L, retaining the exact original-asset timing and allowing positive limits. Positive r makes discounted bounded income summable. The accepted NP01 telescope and natural floor bound nonnegative consumption partial sums; their convergence yields terminal-wealth convergence. The discounted floor tends to zero and forces L≥0. Countable intersections correctly combine datewise almost-sure premises before pathwise application. The actual hypotheses contain no assumed convergence, impatience, optimality, strict consumption positivity or IID restriction. The general measure-space formulation covers feasible adapted probability paths without requiring unused adaptation assumptions. Inspected A93 Proposition 1 supports the argument; detailed series and measure-theoretic steps are project reconstructions. Preservation, exports, axioms and ledger evidence support adequacy independently of compilation.

dimension_assessments.summary: The export concludes a.e. existence of L:ℝ with L≥0 and (1+r)^(-T)*a_(T+1)→L from datewise a.e. feasibility and the exact natural floor. It preserves the terminal exponent and permits positive limits.

Geometric comparison proves income summability. The telescope and floor bound nonnegative consumption partial sums, proving summability. Subtracting the convergent sums gives terminal convergence; comparison with the vanishing discounted floor gives nonnegativity. ae_all_iff correctly supplies common full-measure paths.

The budget uses original assets: c_t+a_(t+1)=(1+r)*a_t+w*labor_t. naturalLimit is w*laborMin/r, and terminal wealth is discounted by T. Adaptation is unnecessary for the forward pathwise implication; removing that unused premise preserves coverage of feasible adapted plans.

Visually inspected extraction page 1 of each PDF: A93 printed 37/original PDF 38 states Proposition 1 and its forward convergence proof; A94 printed 666/original PDF 9, note 16, links borrowing and present value. The ledger identifies detailed summability and a.e. lifting as project reconstructions.

Actual premises are r,w,laborMin>0, bounded labor, c≥0, budgets and the natural floor. naturalLimit_nonneg uses those same positivities; the telescope needs only derived R>0 and budgets. No hidden economic premise appears.

No hypothesis assumes summability, terminal convergence or its sign. The premises admit a_t=0 and c_t=w*labor_t for bounded positive labor, so feasibility is substantive and does not depend on a zero measure.

NP02 uses the accepted NP01 telescope helper. The wrapper adds only the authorized import and assigned theorem; preservation certificates match NP01's type, value, universe, metadata, dependency and axiom fingerprints.

Real-valued asset, consumption and labor paths remain continuous-state. Arbitrary measures and bounded labor cover general compact iid laws, including atoms, without density, finite-support or discretization restrictions.

The proof uses no value derivative or marginal object, including at zero consumption or assets. It therefore preserves the mandatory distinction between positive-state rightMarginalValue and the potentially infinite ENNReal zeroRightMarginal at economic zero.

Income summability precedes its tsum bounds; consumption summability precedes identification of L as the difference of real sums. No integral or ENNReal conversion is used. Finiteness concerns each admissible path and does not assert integrability across paths.

Tendsto establishes ordinary real sequence convergence on each feasible path, then almost everywhere under μ. No weak convergence of laws, expectation limit or moment convergence is substituted for the required terminal-wealth limit.
There is no beta, impatience, smoothness, Euler, optimality or stationarity premise. Consumption is only nonnegative. R>1 follows exactly from the assigned positive-rate assumption.
The inspected new proofs contain no sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide or unsafe bypass. Controller forbidden-pattern and assert_no_sorry checks pass, with explicit coverage of all three exports.
Each new export's actual axiom inventory is exactly propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The controller's 688-declaration audit reports the same permitted union.

The three-export inventory matches elaborated signatures and axiom records. Each export has #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms in both audit files; the public signature matches the inspected wrapper.

The ledger matches actual premises, a.e. quantifiers, exponent, finite nonnegative conclusion and proof. Global status retains NP02 REVIEW_READY and NP03/E01–E03 UNFORMALIZED; TeX/PDF synchronization is controller-verified.

The proof derives the economic no-Ponzi conclusion from original budgets, nonnegative consumption and the actual natural debt floor. It proves finite terminal convergence and nonnegativity rather than assuming either, replacing assets by shifted controls, or imposing zero terminal wealth.

Countable a.e. intersection preserves the datewise probability interpretation. Arbitrary μ and omission of unused adaptation/IID premises strengthen applicability; the ledger discloses this. No conclusion is weakened.

Only the NP02 pathwise theorem, a.e. lift and public wrapper are added. There is no converse, low-income-block argument, optimality result or E01–E03 implementation; later contracts remain unformalized.

The exact contract, substantive convergence proof, inspected source, preserved dependency and complete export audits support NP02 acceptance with HIGH confidence. No blocker remains; GREEN promotion belongs to the controller.
